summary.intent: Get a batch of open, conflicting PRs (#323, #335, #345, #348, #349, #353 and others) merged with main, CI-green and free of review findings, by delegating to subagent workers and independently verifying their reports.
summary.outcome: Conflicts on #323, #348, #349, #353 were resolved and CI verified green; 15 of 16 open PRs are mergeable with all 17 non-review checks passing. #335/#345 (scope rework) still show open findings and #346 fails an intermittent Vite worker-thread test, so two workers were dispatched (a generated-program comparison against TypeScript's checker, and a root-cause hunt for the flake).

repo: Each PR has 17 non-'Entire Gates' CI checks (Audit, Changesets, CI, Coverage, Install matrix on Node 24/26 x npm/pnpm, Lint, MSRV, SemVer, Test jobs). 'Entire Gates' is the review check and passing does not mean findings are cleared.
Local gate before pushing is `just lint doc-check machete typos`; Rust tests run via `cargo nextest run` on caliper-docgen-core, caliper-docgen, caliper-docgen-napi, caliper-docgen-semantic.
Findings are managed with `entire trail finding list` and can be dismissed with a citation of the fixing commit and line.

Worktrees under the main checkout pick up that checkout's node_modules, causing 7 snapshot tests (chakra, mantine, mui, panda, radix, rdt_compat, shadcn) to fail; a real `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` in the worktree or a clean worktree in /tmp fixes it.
Some watch tests and `a_running_process_has_resident_memory` fail only under the sandbox.
Building the native binding rewrites packages/napi/binding.d.ts with declaration reordering; this should be discarded, not committed.
Cache golden snapshot header 'schema N' tracks CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION (29 on main); #348 changed enum data without bumping the version.

code.finding: New TypeScope replaces in_scope_type_params; declaration bodies resolve under their own unfilled params, and type arguments are read in the scope where they were written (AtFile.scope, now Option<TypeScope> where None inherits).
Record's made-up binder is chosen from P, K, Key as the first name not referenced by the value type; MADE_UP_KEY_VARIABLE is now a named constant shared with substitute.rs.
Extract wrapper pinned an empty scope, losing the caller's type parameter; fixed by using None to inherit.
Issue body wording 'The weekly record got worse:' conflicted with the 'needs attention' title/label after merge; fixed in cf938a89.
Optional tuple elements keep their undefined ([number | undefined]); preserving the '?' marker would require a per-element flag on PropType::Tuple, a wire-format change.

workflow: Subagent reports are not trustworthy on their own: re-verifying CI and open-finding counts found #346 failing and #335/#345 still having open findings despite a worker reporting 0.
A '0 open findings' count right after a push may reflect staleness rather than resolution.
A test failing intermittently on two separate PRs is a pattern, so a green rerun proves nothing; loop it under load to measure a failure rate.
When a scope/shadowing model keeps producing new review holes, switch from patching single cases to differential testing against TypeScript's checker with generated colliding-name programs.
Memo caches keyed by printed text can drop file/scope info and create order-dependent output; an order-independence test over forward, reverse and shuffled orders catches this.

friction: Entire Gates findings kept appearing against each round of the scope rework, requiring multiple worker round-trips.
Snapshot tests fail in worktrees due to node_modules symlink/ancestor lookup, masking real results locally.
Intermittent Vite worker-thread test failure (later.session is [] vs later.cold ['Button']) hit #349 and #346.
Worker reported 0 open findings while lists still showed 1 on #335 and 2 on #345.
open_items: Fix #348's 5 open findings (3 medium in extractor/visit.rs:291 x2 and extractor/interface.rs:239) and #349's 5 low findings; user was asked whether to dispatch a worker.
Decide whether the enum shape in #348 needs its own CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION bump to 30.
Resolve #335/#345 open findings, including `Read<{v: T}>` dropping the argument's pinned T scope and the still-open `Box<T>['value']` empty-scope finding.
Root-cause and fix the intermittent Vite worker-thread test failing on #346 (and seen on #349).
Run the oracle on antd and shadcn against the resolver rework; not yet done.
Preserving the '?' on optional tuple elements needs a PropType::Tuple wire-format change (deferred).
Oracle vitest suite could not be run for #323 (no oracle dependencies installed).
Re-verify CI and finding counts after both workers report.
